method.classification: new retrospective exploratory diagnostics; no confirmatory or causal identification claim
method.bootstrap: independently resample pooled whole neutron events within each old thickness, sharing event weights across observables
method.interval: unadjusted descriptive percentile 95%; selected after observing July 16 mm maximum
method.sensitivity: leave-one-event/block calculations do not exclude observations from reported estimates
method.cross_campaign_comparison: old vs current includes independently sampled events and different model/runtime identities; cannot isolate a statistical or physical cause
